name: RoboVista
summary: 由机器人专家标注、覆盖真实机器人决策点的视觉问答基准。
summaryEn: An expert-annotated robot-centric VQA benchmark grounded in real decision points from robotic systems.
scale: 474 questions across 6 domains and 39 task types
scaleZh: 474 道题，覆盖 6 个领域和 39 类任务
organizationsZh: 伯克利自动化实验室合作团队
licenseZh: 见 Hugging Face 数据条款
access: Dataset, viewer, and leaderboard publicly available
accessZh: 数据集、浏览器和排行榜均已公开
verdict: 用真实机器人决策场景诊断视觉模型的具身理解能力
verdictEn: Diagnoses embodied visual understanding through real robot decision scenarios
wmNote: 问题与机器人执行节点对齐，可评估状态理解和行动选择。
wmNoteEn: Questions aligned with robot decision points evaluate state understanding and action selection.
